[quote=yngollund;60086658][b][i]INCIDENT OFF THE COAST OF VIKRONEAI, YNGOLLUND DECLARES WAR[/i][/b]
(mostly a joke post unless Thurgot actually wants to take it seriously, doing it for the bit)

[i]9:18 PM. Clear night with some clouds. It was a nice day out. Something showed up on the radar, however, and military posts stationed around northern Vikroneai were quick to note to their higher ups on the situation.

There was a large but aged warship in the distance. The ship had the flag of Yngollund flying in front of it, the bold colors of yellow, white and black being unmistakable this time of day.[/i]

[b]BOOM[/b]

[i]All of a sudden, an explosion occurred on board, near starboard, and the ship was now burning brightly against the nightly banners. The Vikroneaians were understandably bewildered, however continued observing the ship.

A shape in the sky came about ten minutes later, while the ship was still filling with water, and hovered above the boat. After about thirty seconds of waiting, it flew back in the direction it came.[/i]

(the sinking of the ship was staged)

[b]11 HOURS LATER[/b]

The Yngol Higher Court released a statement over the recent events. They condemned the Vikroneaians for attacking and sinking one of their warships, and declared a state of war between the two states.
